name: Jediael
title: Benjamin's son and patriarch
summary: Jediael was one of Benjamin's sons and a patriarch in the tribe of Benjamin. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as an important clan leader, and his descendants formed a significant part of the tribe of Benjamin with many brave warriors. The name Jediael means 'known by God'.

keyEvents.title: Listed as a son of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jediael is mentioned as one of the three sons of Benjamin in the genealogy of Chronicles, along with Bela and Beker.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Jediael through Bilhan
keyEvents.description: Bilhan, the son of Jediael, had several sons who became leaders of their families in the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: Brave warriors in the lineage of Jediael
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Jediael are counted as 17,200 brave fighting men, ready to go out to battle, testifying to a strong and powerful family line.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Benjamin in Jacob's blessing
keyEvents.description: Benjamin, the father of Jediael, was blessed by Jacob as a ravenous wolf, pointing forward to the warrior nature of the tribe that also characterized the descendants of Jediael.

keyEvents.title: Jediael among David's warriors
keyEvents.description: A person named Jediael is also mentioned among the brave warriors who joined David in Ziklag, which may show the significance of the name within the tribe of Benjamin.
